todos: [P2] QWEN38-FULLTASK-01: qwen3.8:27b still unqualified on the full task. qwen3-coder:30b verified it on 2026-09-26 (audit-20260926c: 8/8, 37/50 steps, 53 min). qwen3.8 rerun-20260926e (2026-09-26, code before the AGENT-DIRECTIVE-AUTHORITY-03 wording change, snapshot %USERPROFILE%\OnlyRag-Live\snapshots\*rerun-20260926e* with session_state.json telemetry): the step-2 cache miss is gone with the append-only transcript (turn 1 cold 5244 tokens in 42.7 s, every later turn evaluates only the appended tokens: 8-12 s up to 21704 prompt tokens), but generation runs at about 2 tok/s (83% CPU, 3.8 of 22.1 GB in VRAM at num_ctx 65536): 7 generations in 128 min, up to 32 min for one 3874-token turn (mostly thinking), and the run closed on step_budget at 25/25 with 0/7 verified and a failing build (TS6133 unused imports, TS2741 missing children). The 25-step ceiling was a harness bug, now fixed: loadRealSettings spread the versioned settings envelope instead of decoding it, so the run used defaults instead of the user settings (maxToolCallSteps 50). Next: a rerun at 50 steps would exceed the 180-minute session limit at this speed; it needs a lower thinking level (modelThinkingPreferences qwen3.8:27b low or false) or a smaller num_ctx that keeps more layers on the GPU, a choice for the user. The older qwen3.8 evidence workspaces were deleted after this analysis.

[P2] AGENT-DIRECTIVE-AUTHORITY-03: Code complete on 2026-09-26, live confirmation pending. Every tool-result and gate text outside the arbiter modules is advice (renderAdvice, or renderAdviceSteps for guards with alternatives); orderAuthority.test.ts scans electron/ and shared/ and fails on ORDER_MARKER outside planDirectiveArbiter, its builders (postVerificationClosure, behaviorTestDirective, entrypointIntegrity, verificationAttemptTracker), diagnosticAdvice, the focus block of planAndSolveGraph and promptPresets; the user-mandated first command is the arbiter decision user_first_command (highest priority, turn 1 only), no longer prepended next to a second order. Verified: typecheck, quality:static, audit:deadcode, audit:cycles, docs:check, test:e2e:electron (8 + 9). Remaining: (1) a live full-task run on the new wording (the qwen3.8 rerun-20260926e started before the change and does not count); (2) guard pruning done on 2026-09-26 by user decision: the redundant loopDetector shell_tool_confusion pattern was removed (TOOL_AS_SHELL_BLOCK refuses each call, execution_budget stops the repetition; E2E guard scenario 6 now asserts that); the other guards that never fired in 86 snapshots are kept as protective (unchanged retry, read loop, premature finish, nested-directory notices, CONTRADICTED BY THE WORKSPACE, partial delivery, DEFINITION OF DONE VIOLATION, fs oscillation, write_file directory refusal, TOOL_AS_SHELL_BLOCK, web research note).

[P3] AGENT-DEV-SERVER-TOOL-01: No background-process tool or port probe for dev servers: run_command refuses them (BLOCKING_DEV_SERVER_BLOCK) and the model is told to leave the start to the user. Deferred by the user on 2026-09-26 until it can be designed together with a live run.

[P3] I18N-MAIN-MESSAGES-01: agent:log carries structured localized keys (shared/domain/agent/agentMainText.ts, English in src/i18n/locales/en.ts agentMain) with the Italian text as logMessage fallback. On 2026-09-26 every tool result producer was migrated through the toolLog helper of toolExecutionContracts.ts (filesystem, web, Git, recovery, process preconditions, ensure_tool, policy and visual validation), and the fixed-language orchestrator emitLog lines (final verification, workspace error, preflight, execution guard, skill router/hub, plan seeding, session timeout). Deliberately left as they are: 'Task Finished:' and the AI Agent Question marker (parsed by agentLogMessageUtils/AgentTimelineMessage), the bracket markers kept inside the localized texts ([SECURITY BLOCK] etc., used for categories) and diagnosticsToolService's 'Agent Question:'. Remaining: sessionDebtTracker markdown (SESSION_TRACKER.md is fed back to the model, so changing it needs a live run), and the Sidecar chunk prefix [Documento: ... | Sezione: ...] (requires a re-index migration).

[P3] THINKING-LEVEL-CHAT-01: Chat (useChatEngine) and translation (useTranslation) send the boolean resolveOllamaThinkingPreference(...).think, and ollamaHttpClient generate sends think: customOptions?.think === true, so a level preference (e.g. qwen3.8:27b low) runs with the model default level (medium) there. Structured generation (interview, plan) was fixed on 2026-09-26 (resolveStructuredThinkValue sends the chosen level); the agent already sends it (resolveAgentThinkValue). Fix: carry OllamaThinkValue through the chat and translation IPC payloads instead of a boolean.

[P3] STRUCTURED-TIMEOUT-01: Structured generation (interview, plan) has a fixed 10-minute request timeout (ollamaHttpClient.generateStructuredNow, req.setTimeout(600000)), unlike the agent stream whose stall limit is speed-based since 2026-09-26. With qwen3.8:27b at about 2 tok/s on the RTX 2070 and thinking enabled, plan generation hit it twice in a row (live thinklow-20260926f, 2026-09-26) and the run never started; derive the limit from num_predict and measured generation speed.
